metadata.pairing: Whole-run exogenous seeds shared across all eight endpoints; identical initial conditions, resources and keyed external draws. Independent model draws are not provider-seed reproducibility.

sample_size.rule: No automatic N choice; old U-only precision rule is retired. Specify T and U precision, missingness and budget before a separate freeze.

outcomes.T_agent: actual agent prompt plus completion tokens; excludes policy generation

inference.contrasts_per_outcome: 7 endpoint-minus-000 and 6 two-factor interactions conditional on the third tool (13 each)
inference.reporting: Raw units, paired whole-run differences and pointwise t intervals; Holm within each outcome's 13-contrast family. No combined score or token-only benefit claim.
inference.missing: Unknown token pairs excluded with explicit unknown counts and known lower bounds; no bounded token imputation. U full-cohort bounds use [0,720].
inference.accounting: Independent request accounting includes queries, repairs and known failed/recovery attempts; finalized and discarded separately. Zero resolved gives NA token-per-resolved.
inference.valid_data: Formal inference requires a separately frozen study and complete independently verified full-horizon current-version LLM source-bound records; offline output is descriptive test-only.

metadata.historical_scope: Strength, order, sensitivity, model replicate and prior pilot designs are historical and are not executable as current-version designs.

runtime_contract.normalization: Exact single-wrapper/agreeing-field/source-prefix compatibility, independently rebuilt from raw responses; no fuzzy candidate IDs or merged hypotheses.
runtime_contract.terminal_model_output: Pause only that run after one repair; do not synthesize wait or replace C analysis with raw delivery.
runtime_contract.topic_rejection: Availability, actual delivery, signal-window, grouping, threshold and active/cooldown failures remain paid-turn business rejections with distinct codes.
runtime_contract.B_confirmation_delivery: Registered current-revision confirmation/objection receipts may be delivered before activation through charged delayed messages. Work still requires full confirmation and lawful handover.
runtime_contract.transport_accounting: Every physical request has a new UUID and receipt; unknown usage stays unknown and excludes complete token comparison.

metadata.authorization: This template does not authorize pilot, paid execution, or freeze sample size.

scope_note: Historical 60-round T_agent/U design; current finite-workload T_system plans are generated by policy_sim.protocol. This file does not authorize execution.
